import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, ref, para, algo

seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0
cnt = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 100
rng = random.Random(seed)
bad=0
for it in range(cnt):
    prof = gen.gen_profile(rng)
    cal = para.build_calib(prof)
    if not cal.feasible: continue
    fb = gen.gen_fabric(rng, cal.K, maxP=14)
    for g in fb['guards_ns']:
        try:
            ok = ref.check(fb, cal, g, extra_cycles=2)
        except Exception as e:
            import traceback; traceback.print_exc(); ok=False
        if not ok:
            bad+=1
            print('FAIL', json.dumps(fb), 'g=',g)
            if bad>2: sys.exit(1)
print('done, bad=',bad)
